title: Slam the Door
hook: His queen is staring at your weakest pawn.
why: One pawn step blocks the queen and saves f7.
whyLong: Early queen raids die to a simple block. Develop after you are safe.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn Glitch is hunting.

glitch.taunt: Just develop a knight. Nothing bad ever happens.
glitch.gloat: Queen takes f7. That's mate. Thanks!

title: Queen Out Too Early
hook: He pushed a pawn at your queen. Look again.
why: The pawn step left e5 loose and the rook behind it.
whyLong: Chase the queen away, but count what the pawn stopped guarding.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the king and the rook in the corner.

glitch.taunt: Your queen is trapped! Run her home to f3.
glitch.gloat: You retreated. My board, my rules.
glitch.rage: My ROOK too?! That pawn move was a MISTAKE?!

title: He Took It Back
hook: He took your horse back. Look at his king.
why: The check comes first and wins the loose pawn behind it.
whyLong: Moving the f-pawn opened a diagonal straight at the king.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the king with no cover.

glitch.taunt: You lost a horse! Just develop the bishop and cope.
glitch.gloat: Cope it is. I am up a whole horse.
glitch.rage: A CHECK? I forgot about the diagonal!

title: Fried Liver
hook: His horse took the wrong pawn back.
why: The horse eats f7 and the king cannot hide.
whyLong: Two attackers on f7 beat one defender.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn two of your pieces attack.

glitch.taunt: Just trade bishop for horse on d5. Simple. Even.

title: No Cheap Heroics
hook: His bishop is out early. Glitch wants fireworks.
why: Take the center. The flashy sacrifice just loses a bishop.
whyLong: Sacrifices need a forced follow-up. If you cannot see one, build instead.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn that grabs the middle.

glitch.taunt: Sacrifice on f7! Be a hero! Kids love sacrifices!
glitch.gloat: You gave away a bishop for a pawn. Hero.
glitch.rage: A boring pawn move?! Where is my fireworks?!

title: Trap the Corner Rook
hook: He kept the gambit pawn. Look at his corner.
why: The queen hits the rook and the loose pawns. It cannot be saved.
whyLong: A piece with no squares is already lost. Attack it, do not trade it.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the rook with nowhere to go.

glitch.taunt: Develop the knight like a good little student.
glitch.rage: My rook can't MOVE?! Who designed this?!

title: He Grabbed Your Pawn
hook: He just ate a pawn. Count the guards.
why: Two of you guard e5. Take the horse back.
whyLong: Before you get fancy, take the free piece.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the horse that took your pawn.

glitch.taunt: Check! Bishop takes f2! Checks are always good!
glitch.gloat: You checked. I kept the horse. Fair swap.
glitch.rage: You just... took it? No flair at all!
